content.comment_body: Hello everyone! I am working on a program but I've hit a roadblock. I want to manually reset counter "B005" using the pushbutton "I1", but [product_name] software isn't allowing this connection. I've attached the program. Any advice would be appreciated. What am I missing? My hardware is [product_name] - [article_no].

Hi, You just need to add another OR block connecting M2 and I1 to the counter's reset input. Note that it isn't possible to link a digital input directly to the output of a block (like the M block in your setup). Also, it looks like you have a [article_no] hardware but chose [article_no] in the software. Be sure to select the correct hardware model in [product_name] to avoid using blocks unavailable on your real device. Best regards,

Oops, you're correct—I was looking at a different [article_no] and forgot to switch back to [article_no]. Simply use another OR block to connect M2 and I1 to the counter's reset input. You can't link a digital input directly to a block's output (such as the M block). Thanks so much! I'll give it a try!

analysis.insight_summary: Users faced issues resetting a counter manually in [product_name] software using a pushbutton input. The main UX concern was selecting a mismatched hardware version in the software, resulting in unavailable function blocks and confusion. Additionally, the interface doesn't permit direct connections from digital inputs to block outputs, which was not clear to the user.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate being able to easily reset counters manually via pushbutton inputs in the software, without limitations, and to have access to all function blocks corresponding to their actual hardware version.
